_note: iOS / App Store spec template. The Android one (APP_SPEC_TEMPLATE.json) is not interchangeable: bundle IDs replace package names, AdMob replaces Petal Ads, Apple's App Privacy questionnaire replaces AppGallery privacy tags, and the locale codes differ.

screens._accessibility_identifiers_note: Every interactive control needs one from day one; the screenshot UI test addresses controls by identifier, never by coordinates.

permissions._usage_description_note: Names the feature and is true. The gate rejects strings under 25 characters and generic phrasings; Apple rejects vague ones under guideline 5.1.1.

integrations._forbidden_note: No Firebase, Amplitude, Mixpanel, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Segment or Sentry: check_ios_app.py fails the build on any of them.

monetization._iap_product_id_note: Non-consumable, <bundle_id>.removeads. Must be created in App Store Connect by hand before it can be purchased.
monetization._ads_never_on_note: Screens and moments where no ad may ever appear. Two of the loudest complaints in every utility category are about ads interrupting the core task.

localization._supported_languages_note: Apple's locale codes, which differ from Huawei's (ar-SA not ar, zh-Hans not zh-CN, it not it-IT, tr not tr-TR). Mirrors defaults.ios.languages.

design._identity_note: Its own palette, icon and copy. The shared factory skeleton is internal and must never be visible: Apple's guideline 4.3 treats template reskins as spam and penalises the whole account.

privacy._collects_personal_data_note: Always true while ads ship: the AdMob SDK collects device and advertising identifiers. Apple's App Privacy answers must say so.
privacy._support_url_note: Apple requires a support URL; GitHub Pages under docs/<slug>/support/ satisfies it.

privacy_manifest._note: Goes into PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy. Data types use Apple's NSPrivacyCollectedDataType* labels; required-reason APIs use their approved reason codes.

app_privacy_answers._note: What to tick in App Store Connect's App Privacy questionnaire. Manual the first time. With AdMob this means identifiers and usage data used for third-party advertising, and 'used to track you' when ATT is accepted.

qa._acceptance_criteria_note: Testable statements with numbers, not adjectives. 'Recording a price for a known item takes at most 4 taps plus the number' is testable; 'entry is fast' is not.
